pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark, polygonal patches with sharp edge gradients. Geometry is primarily irregular quadrilaterals and pentagons with a high area-to-perimeter ratio on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes ventrally.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored negative space forming an interconnected grid. Junction nodes are primarily tri-valent and tetra-valent. Corridor pixel thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the primary dorsal-lateral field.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous mane from upper neck to shoulder with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile. Silhouette edges are well-defined against the blue sky background.

other_distinctive_markers: A yellow-billed oxpecker (Buphagus africanus) is attached to the left lateral neck, presenting a distinct color contrast (yellow/red) against the dark brown neck patches.
